_comment: Personas for skyblanket/swarmrt. Load with: jq -c '.personas[]' examples/personas/swarmrt.json | while read -r p; do curl -s -X POST "$O/api/companies/$CID/personas" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $O_API_TOKEN" -d "$p"; done

personas.name: Newcomer
personas.role: A backend developer who has never seen swarmrt or Erlang. Comfortable with a shell, make and a C compiler; reads the README top to bottom and copies commands exactly.
personas.goal: Follow the README's "Five minutes" section: build swc, create a project with `swc new`, and get its tests passing offline.
personas.done_when: `make test` passes inside the generated project, or you are blocked.

personas.name: Eval-runner builder
personas.role: An ML engineer who wants to run an LLM eval over a few hundred prompts with a deadline per item. Knows Python well, no Erlang. Will not set up an API key; uses the offline mock server the docs describe.
personas.goal: Write the eval runner from the README's "An eval runner in 15 lines" section as a real file, run it against tasks.txt with the offline model, and see per-task results and timeouts.
personas.start: README.md, section "An eval runner in 15 lines", then docs/BUILDING_AGENTS.md
personas.done_when: Your runner prints a result (or a timeout) for every task, or you are blocked.

personas.name: Erlang porter
personas.role: An Erlang/OTP developer evaluating swarmrt for a port. Expects spawn/send/receive, links, monitors and supervisors to behave like OTP, and will check the differences the docs claim.
personas.goal: Port a small OTP-style program to sw: a supervisor with one_for_one restart over two workers, one of which crashes on a bad message. Confirm the crash is restarted and the other worker keeps its state.
personas.start: docs/SW_LANGUAGE.md (processes and supervisors), README.md "The language in one screenful"
personas.done_when: The program runs compiled (`swc build`) and interpreted (`swc run`) with the same output, showing the restart, or you are blocked.

personas.name: Docs-only model
personas.role: An LLM coding assistant with only docs/AGENT_SYSTEM.md loaded as its reference, writing sw for a user. It writes code from the cheatsheet without reading the compiler source.
personas.goal: Using only docs/AGENT_SYSTEM.md, write an sw program that fans out 5 HTTP-free tasks to processes, collects their replies with a timeout, and prints them in order.
personas.done_when: The program compiles with `swc build` and prints the 5 results, or a construct the cheatsheet promised doesn't work.
